My main focus is Android development, but I also take on full-stack tasks when needed. I enjoy building products that are reliable, easy to maintain, and genuinely useful to the people who use them.

about.title: About me
about.personalDescription:
I'm Nguyen Phuc Thanh, an Android developer based in Hanoi.

I currently lead the Android development of HeyJapan — a Japanese learning app trusted by more than 7 million users. My work focuses on building and improving the Android application using Kotlin, ensuring the system remains stable, scalable, and capable of supporting a large user base.

Beyond Android, I also have experience working on web and backend components when needed, but mobile development remains my main focus. I care a lot about clean architecture, maintainable code, and building systems that can grow over time without becoming difficult to manage.

services.title: Mobile application development
services.description: Developing Android (Kotlin) or Flutter applications for real-world use cases, integrating backend APIs, Firebase services, ML Kit, and third-party SDKs when needed.

services.title: Full-stack web development
services.description: Building web applications with React or Next.js and backend systems using Node.js or Flask, focusing on reliability, maintainability, and scalability.

services.title: Machine learning integration
services.description: Integrating machine learning models and image-processing features such as OCR, face detection or recognition, and data analysis into mobile and web applications.

services.title: UI/UX and prototyping
services.description: Designing clear, user-friendly interfaces and building quick prototypes to validate ideas before moving into full implementation.

projects.description: Viettel EID/Passport verification app – an Android kiosk solution with liveness detection, NFC reading, OCR (MRZ), and integrated payment processing.
A full-stack platform designed to manage Android-based Face Terminal devices, including real-time monitoring, access log tracking, and remote APK updates.
Coffee shop website and mobile app – a full-stack project (React / Node / MySQL + React Native) with user and admin roles, product browsing, and feedback features.
Raincaster – a real-time weather forecasting platform using an SVM model with a Flask backend and React frontend, focused on rainfall prediction.
DSoft – a Flutter-based spa and wellness management application covering appointment booking, staff scheduling, inventory management, payments, and basic analytics.
More projects are available on my GitHub — feel free to explore.
